error.message: The loop through MIXER1, CP1, HE1, FLASH1, CP2, VALVE3, HE2, FLASH2, CP3, VALVE2, HE3, MIXER2, HE4, SPLIT1, HE5, REACTOR1, REACTOR2, HE6, TRACES, MIXER3, HE7, FLASH4, COLUMN, FLASH3, SPLIT3, MIX-TOP, SPLIT2, VALVE1, MIXER5, CPREC, MIXER4 did not converge: at iteration 3, Column COLUMN: the rigorous column did not converge. Tried: Newton from the bubble-point start, steps of at most 20 K (4 iterations, 2503 ms: the residual stopped falling); continuation in the relative volatilities (stopped at 0 % of the way, after 1 steps, 406 ms); Newton resumed from where the bubble-point start stopped, without the early stop (8 iterations in all, 250 ms: the residual stopped falling); continuation in the relative volatilities, the mean weighted by the liquid (stopped at 0 % of the way, after 1 steps, 1789 ms). Last residuals: material 12.67 mol/s, equilibrium 3.942e-7, energy 1497000 W, specifications 0.0182. With the vapour + liquid condenser the reflux ratio is the reflux over the liquid distillate (L1 / U1): a small liquid distillate (a large vapour share) means a small reflux; give the reflux by another specification (a duty, a boil-up ratio) where most of the distillate leaves as vapour. This does not show that the column has no solution: try other specifications (a larger reflux, another product flow), more stages, or another feed stage. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 2.4 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 6.62e-1. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (19, 35, 26, 28, 39-REC) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
